newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX May Brent up, capped by $18.00, API neutral.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX May Brent up, capped by $18.00, API neutral.

text.p: Brent crude prices were bid at slightly higher levels in Asia compared with the settlement in London overnight, with API data failing to offer any clear direction.
May Brent on SIMEX was untraded but bid at $17.98 cents per barrel, up five cents from London's overnight settlement on the IPE at $17.93.
June was quoted at $18.00/$18.30 from London's settlement of $18.10.
Brokers said Brent has been hesitating in recent days, unable to hold above $18.00 but not testing last week's low of $18.65.
They said overnight API stock data looked neutral and so did not offer any fresh direction.
A fall in distillate and gasoline stocks and a rise in crude stocks were broadly in line with expectations.
The NYMEX complex was firm in the wake of the API statistics.
May crude was last traded at $19.47 on ACCESS, up 12 cents from New York. Volume was 822 lots.
